## Problem and change

Explain the user-facing problem and focused solution. Link an issue if applicable.

## Verification

List commands and device checks actually run, with results. Clearly state checks
not run or known failures; do not describe planned testing as completed.

## Data, compatibility and UI

Explain migrations, import/backup compatibility or scheduler/reminder changes when
relevant. For UI changes, attach synthetic/redacted before/after screenshots and
note light/dark, Arabic/RTL, mixed text, small-width and font-scale checks.

## AI assistance

If applicable, name the AI tools used and what you reviewed/verified yourself.

## Checklist

- [ ] I read CONTRIBUTING.md and CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md.
- [ ] This change is focused, with relevant tests/documentation updated.
- [ ] Existing study data is preserved; any schema change has a safe migration.
- [ ] No personal backups, private study content, credentials or signing keys are included.
- [ ] Any added dependencies/assets have appropriate permissions and notices.
- [ ] I disclosed checks not run and known limitations.
